mathematical_findings: For the stated F0 split, the central triangle has zero exterior incidence. The block SRG identity gives R = 12I + 2J - H^T H - D^2 - D = H2^T H2 with exactly eighteen unknown rows.

The reconstructed H has sixty distinct binary triples. Symmetric loop-free D is required to have degree eight and to satisfy all 1080 mixed equations and 1770 pair caps. This makes diagonal R equal three and the checked off-diagonal entries lie in {0,1,2}.
The binary inequality R_uv + R_uw - R_vw <= 3 follows coordinatewise from a(1-b)(1-c) + (1-a)bc >= 0. All 102660 orientations are checked on a passing sixty-vertex input.
Schur elimination retains exact congruence vectors. A negative pivot or nonzero off-diagonal in a zero-diagonal remainder yields an independently evaluated negative quadratic form.
Nineteen positive pivots give a nonzero nineteen-by-nineteen principal minor. The verifier computes that determinant with separate integer Bareiss elimination.

A passing certificate supplies positive rational rank-one factors whose sum is checked entrywise against R, plus a positive principal minor confirming the recorded rank. Rank at most eighteen and positive semidefiniteness therefore have exact acceptance proofs.
